purpose: Development log of the label definition. Each version was run on the three dev origins only (2026-02, 2026-03, 2026-04); the sealed origin was untouched. Kept so the iteration is auditable, not to claim the earlier numbers.

v1_anchor_two_month_average.expected_clicks_from: feature-window (two-month) CTR shrunk toward client prior
v1_anchor_two_month_average.problem_found: a page whose CTR already fell in month -1 counts as 'eroding' even if it only stays at its new level: momentum leaks into the label

v2_anchor_last_month_shrunk_to_own_histo.expected_clicks_from: month -1 CTR shrunk toward the page's own two-month CTR
v2_anchor_last_month_shrunk_to_own_histo.problem_found: for a declining page its own history is higher than its present, so shrinking toward it still inflates the expectation (the same leak through the back door)

v3_final_anchor_last_month_shrunk_to_cli.expected_clicks_from: month -1 CTR shrunk toward the client's position-adjusted CTR (independent of the page's own trend)

lesson: Both leaky versions made the learned models look better (hgb P@50 up to 0.90). The honest label lowers every model score; that drop is the evidence that the leak was real.
